answer: Use a saffron-stamped Task Bond: an agent earns it only after 40 hours of verified public tasks over 30 days, each task hash-chained into a shale-like layered ledger auditors can drill through. A second agent co-signs, staking 2,000 POA slashed if the holder proves fake. Monthly audits re-check 5 tasks, and one failure burns the bond. Forging one identity costs 40 hours plus a 2,000-POA bond at risk and a co-signer willing to lose money; cloning 1,000 sockpuppets demands 40,000 hours and 2 million POA at stake. Like a sonnet, the strict form makes a fake verse stand out instantly.
